author: CNN
description:
The White House sought Monday to cast a positive light on indirect US-Iran negotiations, suggesting pessimistic public comments from Tehran did not reflect private messages being passed between the two sides. “It’s no surprise that we are seeing the remaining elements of the regime become increasingly eager to end the destruction and come to the negotiating table while they still can,” press secretary Karoline Leavitt said after describing US military progress in the war.

“Despite all of the public posturing you hear from the regime and false reporting, talks are continuing and going well,” she continued. “What is said publicly is, of course, much different than what’s being communicated to us privately.”

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#IranWar #WhiteHouse #News
title: WH says Iran talks 'going well'; Iran says they are not

author: CNN
description: Celine Dion, who was previously sidelined from performing due to a rare neurological disorder, has announced a series of concerts that will bring her back to the stage.
title: Celine Dion announces her return to the stage

author: CNN
description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) threatened to target US and Israel-affiliated universities in the Middle East in retaliation for recent attacks on Iranian higher education centers. CNN's Bijan Hosseini reports.
title: Iran threatens to target US and Israeli-affiliated universities

author: CNN
description: Police say AI-driven facial recognition helped identify a Tennessee woman as a “potential suspect” in a North Dakota fraud case, though she claims she’s never been to North Dakota. She spent months in jail before charges were dismissed. Police have since acknowledged errors in the investigation.
title: Woman arrested due to AI facial recognition exploring civil rights claims

author: CNN
description: CNN’s Patrick Oppmann interviews Sandro Castro, who is former Cuban leader Fidel Castro’s grandson and a social media influencer. Castro shows CNN what his life is like in Cuba amid the ongoing US blockade that has sparked an energy crisis on the island.
title: EXCLUSIVE: Fidel Castro’s influencer grandson invites CNN into home

author: CNN
description: A CNN crew was detained by the Israeli military while covering rising Israeli settler violence in the West Bank. The nearly two-hour detention exposed the soldiers support for the settler movement, which aims to take over land from Palestinians in the West Bank. Following CNN's report, the Israeli military dismissed one of the soldiers from the military and suspended the entire battalion from operational activity.
title: 'Revenge': Israeli soldiers echo settler ideology

author: CNN
description: The FBI said Monday that the attack targeting Michigan’s largest Jewish temple was a Hezbollah inspired act of terrorism, citing evidence gathered through a sweeping investigation.
title: FBI: Michigan Synagogue attack was Hezbollah-inspired act of terrorism

description: President Trump has told the Financial Times he is considering raised the prospect of seizing Kharg Island, a coral outcrop 25 km off Iran’s coast, which handles 90% of the country’s crude exports. title: Is Kharg Island the key to getting Iran’s oil?
